`OpenReview`. For `in.Task`: roster from `taskReviewers`, defaulted per
Decisions when empty; `in.BaseRef` required (a 40-hex sha; anything else
`ErrInvalidInput`); state rule per Decisions and WL-1022; insert `reviews`
with `subject 'change'`, `task_id`, `base_ref = in.BaseRef`; mint one
`kind = 'review'` task per reviewer with `assignee` set, through the
task-creation path part 1's document arm uses, then `AddEdge(tx, now,
task, reviewTask, "dependsOn", eventID)`; the body per Decisions with each
PR's URL from `PRsForTask`. `reviewAuthor` for a task subject is part 1's
(active lease holder, else `assignee`, else `""`). `model.OpenReviewInput`
and `model.Review` gain `Reason`; `wl:reason` joins `ns/ontology.ttl` and
`payloadProperties[TypeReviewOpened]` (`internal/eventbus/vocab.go`,
`vocab_test.go`), and `wl:ReviewOpened` carries it. `ReviewForTask(ctx,
taskID)` returns the open review with `Reason` read from its
`wl:ReviewOpened` event; `GetReview` fills `Reason` the same way.
`model.TaskDetail` gains `Review *Review`, filled by the task detail read.
